headline: NVIDIA reported record revenue in the third quarter of the year
summary: Nvidia reported record revenue for its third fiscal quarter. Its data center division generated $107.6 billion, which the report identifies as the core of its financial expansion.
why: Nvidia is a Santa Clara-based chipmaker whose AI accelerators are central to data center buildouts. Its results are a key read on AI infrastructure spending.
